description: This file defines the internal static class 'DefaultClientServices' which configures and registers default services and components for an Orleans client via dependency injection. It includes methods for adding services, applying configuration, and internal helper classes, mostly for setting up Orleans client runtime environment.

classes.name: DefaultClientServices
classes.description: A static class responsible for setting up default Orleans client services via dependency injection, including configuration and registration of runtime components.

classes.name: AllowOrleansTypes
classes.description: A private class implementing ITypeNameFilter that allows types from assemblies with 'Orleans' in their name, to facilitate serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: RootConfiguration
classes.description: A partial class used internally to hold configuration sections related to clustering.

classes.name: ServicesAdded
classes.description: A marker class used internally to prevent multiple additions of core services.

methods.name: AddDefaultServices
methods.description: Configures and registers various Orleans client services into the dependency injection container.

methods.name: ApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Applies specific configuration sections to the Orleans client builder, registering providers and configuring options.
